messages:
elaine: incoming pen-test report from VendorX attached. highlights: one HIGH (staging service account), two MED, several LOW. tagging ops + eng for RBAC/KMS bits. link to report https://files.vendorx/report-123
samir: thanks. quick Q — report calls out a hardcoded service account ARN in staging that can decrypt the KMS key. is that the ephemeral CI key or the customer-managed KMS?
elaine: staging uses the customer-managed key via kms-proxy; the hardcoded ARN is from an old deploy job that wasn't rotated. risk: potential exposure of staging secrets if exploited.
tasha: can we rotate that key and revoke the role before retest? i can implement a short-lived role + update the deploy pipeline. estimate 2 hours for changes and tests.
ben (security): we need an audit trail for the rotation + a presigned snapshot of KMS/cloudtrail logs for the assessor. retention preference: 90 days, region us-west-2. include sha256 hashes of snapshots.
oncall-ops: note: rotating the key requires a config rollout to dedicated staging nodes. plan: canary to 2 nodes, verify decrypts in canary, then roll. ETA ~4 hours end-to-end including CI.
samir: tagging tasha — when you create the short-lived role, add a Condition block (SourceIp + MFA) and ensure session duration <= 1h. create a JIRA PT-487 and link here.
tasha: created PT-487 and a draft runbook. runbook excerpt: ```bash
# assume temporary role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-ephemeral --duration-seconds 3600
# use the role to call KMS decrypt/encrypt, then revoke old role
```
ci-bot: pipeline-staging triggered for PT-487 by tasha at 2026-03-21T15:10:00Z — build 482 will run canary jobs.
ben (security): also need log-sampling proof: we'll pull KMS API logs + CloudTrail events covering the window +/- 24h; produce hashed bundle and upload to artifact-bucket with presigned URL. example hash: sha256:3f7b9c2f...
elaine: assessor wants retest windows next week. candidate slots: Tue 2026-03-24 09:00-11:00 UTC or Thu 2026-03-26 13:00-15:00 UTC. preferences?
assessor-team: Thu 03/26 13:00-15:00 UTC works better for our schedulers. we prefer minimal config churn on test day; confirm final timing after rotation completes.
oncall-ops: locking Thu. i'll book ops coverage + create an oncall pad with rollback steps. if the rotation breaks anything we have a fallback key variant to fail back to.
samir: post-remediation QA checklist (to be recorded in PT-487): 1) revoke old role; 2) confirm no service calls used old key in last 24h; 3) ingest audit snapshot to S3 and record hash; 4) tag artifacts and hand off to assessor. I'll own items 1-3.
ben (security): i'll own evidence verification during retest. i'll verify log integrity, CloudTrail entries, and RBAC policy diffs.
elaine: great. tasha + oncall-ops, update PT-487 with timeboxed notes and link to artifacts. tagging product for awareness of any customer-impacting delays.
product: noted — minimal user-facing impact expected. will update status page only if rollout hits the rollback corridor.
elaine: closing loop: we'll mark this thread resolved once the assessor confirms retest pass and evidence is uploaded. thanks all :thumbsup:
